rationale: The original short thesis relied on price stalling beneath the 5-minute 9-EMA on declining volume, but BA has instead reclaimed the 5-minute 9-EMA ($166.48) and pushed higher across five consecutive 1-minute candles with volume expanding to 77,877 shares on the latest bar.
